description: Incidents les plus importants en terme d'impact sur la ponctualité - Belangrijkste incidenten en gevolgen voor de stiptheid - Most important incidents in terms of impact on trains punctuality is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Infrabel. Monthly list of incidents whose impact added up to more than 1000 minutes of delay to passenger trains. The number of minutes attributed to each incident is shown, as well as the number of cancelled trains, the place and the number of the line on which the incident occurred. Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 1 resource in CSV. The data standards named are other. The national access point types are MMTIS. The portal shows 2024-12-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
